source.paraphrase: A durability requirement must verify the queue's actual repository and persistence mode. Setting enabled to true or registering a system persistence singleton must not be treated as proof of persistence.

invariants.why: A durability requirement must verify the queue's actual repository and persistence mode. source.paraphrase: A lagging-persistence queue must have an owned loss window, background lifetime and failure policy. Successful enqueue must not be reported as durable completion. A background storage failure must be observed and acted on.

invariants.why: A lagging-persistence queue must have an owned loss window, background lifetime and failure policy. Successful enqueue must not be reported as durable completion.
